<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "
    <!ENTITY ent 'Parsed Entity Data'>
    <!NOTATION png SYSTEM 'image/png'>
    <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM 'ext.png' NDATA png>
  ">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- This is a comment containing an entity reference &ent; -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with <tags>, &ent;, and other entities inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child id="elem2">&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY base "CatalogBase">
  <!ENTITY composite "&base; & Extended">
  <!ENTITY % extEnt "
    <!ENTITY nestedEnt 'Nested &base;'>
  ">
  %extEnt;
]>
<?processing-instruction target="afl" data="test=true"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:m="http://example.org/org">
  <!-- Comment 1: testing namespace boundaries -->
  <m:item id="i1">
    <?m:pi data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like syntax inside CDATA --></m:item>
    ]]>
  </m:item>
  <item id="i2">&composite; and &nestedEnt;</item>
</catalog>
```

      <!ENTITY deepEnt "Deep">
    '>

  ">
  %extDecl;
]>

<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:aux="http://doc.org/aux" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <aux:section xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing <aux:section>&localEnt;</aux:section>
    ]]>
  </aux:section>
  <section>&localEnt;</section>
</document>

  ">

]>

<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Archival comment with entity &e3; -->
  <meta:record id="rec1" xlink:type="simple">
    <?meta:action execute="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload: &e3; with <brackets> & entities
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
  <record>¯oEnt;</record>
</archive>

  <!ENTITY sample "SampleData">
  <!ENTITY reference "&sample; Reference">
  <!ENTITY % entGroup "
    <!ENTITY pEnt 'ParameterEntityValue'>
    <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM 'text/plain'>
    <!ENTITY extTxt 'external.txt' NDATA txt>
  ">
  %entGroup;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/store">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment -->
  <store:item>
    <?store:directive action="skip"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA block with entity reference &reference; and markup <item>
    ]]>
  </store:item>
  <item>&reference; &pEnt;</item>
</inventory>
